recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel portrait composition framed by a thick black border, featuring a central white rectangular window containing three overlapping character portraits. The layout uses a stark black, white, and red color palette with prominent serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The central white photo window is framed by a heavy black outer border.
The main title overlaps the top edge of the photo window.
Three portraits are arranged in a staggered, overlapping depth-of-field composition.
The bottom text is anchored within the black border, separate from the photo window.
coreInvariants: Stark white background within the inner photo frame.
High-contrast lighting on the subjects' faces.
A primary accent color of deep red for the main title.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three portraits occupy the center; one large male figure on the left, one large female figure on the right, and a smaller female figure peeking from the middle background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red serif title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red title, move down to the central portraits, and finish at the white sans-serif text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the outer frame; clean white negative space behind the portraits.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black frame and white photo background; low saturation except for the red title.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tall x-height and elongated ascenders.
Tight kerning with character overlaps (ligature-like behavior).
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' descender curls sharply to the left.
Letters are vertically compressed and horizontally condensed.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a clean, spaced-out sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular stroke outlining the photo area.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the 80s corporate aesthetic.
Provides the necessary verticality and stroke contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square layout with a thick black outer border. Inside the border, place a white rectangular window. Inside the window, place three portraits: a man in a suit on the left, a woman with dark curly hair on the right, and a woman with red hair peeking between them. Use 80s studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red serif title at the top, overlapping the white frame. Add a line of all-caps white sans-serif text at the very bottom within the black border.

verificationChecks: Is the title text red with a white outline?
Are the letters in the title overlapping?
Is there a clear white rectangle inside a black frame?
Is the bottom text all-caps and widely spaced?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red title is the most saturated element.
Check that the photo background is pure white.
Verify the bottom text is perfectly centered in the black margin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stark black frame + white photo window + overlapping portraits + high-contrast red serif title = 80s Corporate Drama Aesthetic.
